items.title: Satlyt takes another step toward turning satellites into space data centers
items.summary: Satlyt ran a successful test this month bringing it closer to turning spacecraft, starting with satellites,  into virtual data centers.
items.creator: Dominic-Madori Davis

items.title: Zest’s new AI agent finds restaurants and books reservations over text
items.summary: Can't agree on where to eat? Zest's AI concierge can combine everyone's tastes, put restaurant options to a vote, and make the reservation.
items.creator: Sarah Perez
